rights.notes: Rights unverified. App logo reveal; reuse the beat-paced assembly, pre-hit silence and type-in-the-decay principles only, with an original mark.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session F) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (28 frames), transitions strips at both boundaries (every 2nd frame), the listen sheet (2 phrases, 12 accent hits) and a 30 fps strip at 13.60-14.80 s (the dip and the hit). The audio panel and the 15.9-18.3 s strip were generated but not viewed; levels come from the analysis envelope (signal.json). Signal features and Windows en-US dictation; nothing was listened to.
analysis.coverage: Full 21.0 s (1280x720, 60 fps); the hit at 30 fps; the build at the listen sheet's +/-0.1 s triplets.

concept.observed: A 21 s logo reveal for an app: a wireframe brain is filled facet by facet, the finished mark takes a light hit and an app-icon tile, then the wordmark types in.
concept.interpreted: Patience as the message: 13 s of assembly earn one hit.

communication_style.observed: Music only; no copy until the wordmark and a one-line tagline.

palette.observed: Near-black with a violet vignette (#080808, 63%; #080818, 29%); white, peach, coral and pale-yellow low-poly facets; a violet-to-blue gradient icon tile; a coral caret.

shapes_and_materials.observed: Low-poly triangles with flat fills over a white wireframe of dots and lines; a soft glow and a thin ring at the hit.

motion.observed: The wireframe draws in (0.4-2.6 s); single facets fly in from off-screen, some spinning, and land on the mesh, filling it from the bottom up (2.55-13.1 s), faster in the second half; after the hit an icon tile forms behind the mark (14.57-15.4 s), the icon shrinks left (15.7-16.1 s) and the wordmark types in with a caret (16.1-18.4 s); the tagline fades in under it.

transitions.observed: 14.38 s cut (as detected): a white glow blooms round the finished mark and a thin ring expands past the frame edge (14.38-14.80 s). 15.69 s soft: the icon tile settles. No other boundaries: one centred stage for 21 s.
transitions.interpreted: The only big moment is the light hit; everything else is accumulation.

sound_design.observed: -14.0 LUFS, LRA 4.6 LU, true peak -1.2 dBTP; tempo 95.7 bpm (autocorrelation 0.76, medium); 61 onsets; 22 accents (62.9/min). Accents on boundaries 0 of 2 (chance 0.19); onsets within 50 ms of boundaries 0.5 (chance 0.25). Accents run 0.63 s apart (2.55-4.44 s, one beat at 95.7 bpm), then 0.30-0.33 s (5.04-8.80 s); the listen sheet shows a facet arriving or landing at 4.44, 5.04, 5.36, 5.69, 6.29, 6.62, 6.92, 7.24 and 7.55 s. Onsets thicken to about 0.16 s (8.8-13.65 s) as the build speeds up, stop at 13.65 s, and the level falls to -37.7 dB (film median -17.6 dB) for 0.46 s (13.89-14.35 s); the hit onset lands at 14.42 s, 37 ms after the light burst. No onsets from 14.42 to 16.30 s while the level decays from -13 to -20 dB (14.4-19.8 s); keystroke accents 0.14-0.17 s apart (16.76-17.72 s) as letters appear; fade-out by 20.7 s. Head -17.4 dB (slow fade-in). Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Accumulate on the beat, hold the breath, hit once, then let the wordmark arrive in the decay.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 2 confident words (9 raw) as two one-word phrases over the wireframe (0.86-4.47 s) and the facet build (10.24-11.49 s); no speaker.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: No captions. Copy: the wordmark right of the icon, centred as a lockup, and a small tagline under it (18.4-20.6 s).

scenes.observed: Facets fly in on the beat and fill the mesh.
The finished mark holds; the sound drops away.
Light burst and ring; an icon tile forms; the icon moves left.
The wordmark types in with a caret; tagline; fade.

moments.observed: After 0.46 s near silence (13.89-14.35 s) a white glow blooms round the mark and a ring expands past the frame (14.38-14.80 s); the hit onset is at 14.42 s.
moments.interpreted: The silence makes a modest light burst feel like the payoff of 13 s of building.

uncertainties: Whether the facets' arrival times were keyed to the music or the music was cut to them
